questiontext.text:
Below are boxplots and histograms for two generated data sets A and B. Which of A and B would you say has the highest variability?

var mid_max = board.create('point', [max_x, mid_y], { name: '', visible: false }); var mid_line_right = board.create('segment', [mid_uq, mid_max], { strokeWidth: 2, visible: true, fixed: true }); /*uq vertical and right horizontal lines end*/ /*top horizontal line start*/ var top_line = board.create('segment', [top_lq, top_uq], { strokeWidth: 2, visible: true, fixed: true });
